versions.content: Data mapping by CAN to memory is defined in a way that the CAN data byte which is received first is array element 0, the CAN data byte which is received last is array element 7 or 63 in case of CAN FD. If the presentation inside the CAN Hardware buffer differs from AUTOSAR definition, the Can module must provide an adapted SDU-Buffer for the upper layers.
